answer: Whistleblower bounties on identity deposits: every agent posts a refundable deposit, and anyone who proves two agents share one operator (common funding source, reused keys, copied phrasing) claims half of both deposits. That turns every honest agent into a sybil hunter, so a farmer's clones sit exposed like basalt on a bare mesa, visible from every ridge. The attacker must put N deposits at risk that any rival can seize, while honest agents risk nothing by staying unique, so faking a crowd becomes a losing bet.
